claims.statement: The Reverb engine has kNumModes = 6 in V2 mode order (Plate 0, Spring 1, Room 2, Chamber 3, Hall 4, Digital 5; Reverb.h case 0..5). Decay caps kMaxDecayMsByMode[6] = {2500 (Plate), 2500 (Spring), 2000 (Room), 3000 (Chamber), 3500 (Hall), 2750 (Digital)} ms. UI type chips (m00398 rename, EffectTile.cpp:142,151): mode-name row {PLT, SPR, RM, CHM, HALL, DAT} and type-name row {PLT, SPR, SML, CHM, HAL, DAT} — Plate '140' -> PLT, Spring 'RV1' -> SPR, Digital 'DIG' -> DAT. P2 density-uplift constants (2026-10-16, reverb-budget-quality-uplift pass): Room kRoomWashRef = 1.20 (P2.3 fullness norm; the P1 row measured HALF the reference's fullness) and Chamber kChamberWashFrac = 1.60 (P2.4 body-level uplift), both with public test hooks (roomNormTest_, chamberWashFracTest_) and probe-suite guards. Spring (P2.2), Hall (P2.5), and Digital (P2.6) were DECLINED in-family — the P1 baseline rows already sat inside or above their reference IRs.

MODE/SUBTYPE (type) tuning rule — GENERAL across all effects (plate/'140' is the instance): a mode + model/subtype (Params::type[mode] axis, numTypes(), defaultDialsForType(), UI type chip e.g. the '140' Plate chip = mode 0 type 0 in V2 mode order) MAY carry its own knob defaults and its own tone law tuned against its own reference IR — permissive (CAN, not MUST) — but it must NEVER override the generic/shared path or the OTHER modes (bit-identical pins keep them separate: shared comb lines, norm/wash, convolver, and 15-digit pins for every other mode). defaultDialsForType currently returns false (no type override shipped yet). The same rule applies to delay subtypes (Straight/Mod/BBD/Mem), compressor subtypes, chorus/tape subtypes — each may have its own defaults and law (tuned to ITS reference) provided the generic path stays separate.

Spring (mode 1) metallic body + boing: the incommensurate resonator cluster (kSpringR1..R3 gains, IR-driven ears-pass — the 1.3–2.8 kHz pings lifted ~+4 dB RELATIVE to the 220–900 Hz body modes, ping + sparkle) replaces the old single-2-kHz boing ring, which is DISABLED (kSpringBoingGain = 0.000, 'replaced by the R1/R2/R3 cluster'; earlier value 0.028). Body gain kSpringBodyGain = 0.018 (modest — 'body is under the metal, not over it').

Plate/'140' (mode 0 in V2 mode order, type 0 = EMT 140 model) is tuned against the EMT 140 2.0 s IR convolved through the house BudgetConvolver, BOTH sides peak-normalised, with the reference's OWN numbers measured first (the reference itself drifts +4.85 dB and carries 4.3 dB of steady comb, so the guard must pass for the reference). SHIPPED constants (2026-10-13 final pass, density uplift 2026-10-16): air law kPlateAirHzBright = 4900, kPlateAirHzDark = 3600, kPlateAirStages = 2 (two 1st-order OUT-stage LPF stages, LONGER = DARKER is the MEASURED direction across the EMT 140 family); body kPlateBodyHz = 550; onset 3 taps kPlateOnsetDelayMs = {14.2, 26.9, 51.3} ms; wash kPlateWashAp = 0.62 / kPlateWashRef = 0.244; bloom kPlateBloomFrac = 0.32; kPlateColorAmt = 0.3. P2.1 DENSITY UPLIFT (2026-10-16, reverb-budget-quality-uplift pass): kPlateDecayLift = 1.15 (was 1.104 — the WINNING axis: sweep 1.104 -> full 27.2 / comb 35.8; 1.15 -> full 32.5 / comb 34.8, t2000 lands AT the EMT 140 reference's OWN 1.0 s level = inside the family, not overshoot; 1.20+ beats the ref's 2 s number or saturates, DECLINED) and kPlateFbCeilingUp = 0.965 (was 0.940; drift-safe: 0.965*1.03 = 0.994 < 1 under the shared +-3% fbDrift — the 0.975 value would be UNSTABLE, DECLINED; the ceiling binds only >=~2400 ms dials). Public test hooks plateCeilTest_ / plateLiftTest_ (0 = shipped const) gate the sweeps (Reverb.h:1299-1300). Guard re-pins 2026-10-16 (user-authorized leeway, same-family-not-IR target): level-law baseline 93.95 @2000 ms (was 78.23), comb cap 21.98 @2500 ms (was 19.39+1dB). All other five reverb modes bit-identical; R2's shared Mod lives in a separate gated post-mix stage (processSharedModSmear), not inside the plate law.

CONSIDERED & DECLINED (2026-10-13 final pass; keep the full block; do NOT re-try blind): (1) in-loop darkening/body (comb +4.7 to +10 dB, fb-capped gain, one unstable); (2) 2nd-order biquad out-stages at low fc MEASURED UNSTABLE (unnormalised peaking; pole radius 1.127 to NaN), DC-DEAD (lowpass form DC gain 0.035 = a resonator not a lowpass; 6-12 kHz passed uncut), or wrong-shape (a 240 Hz peaking at 600 Hz-1.2 kHz) -- ONLY 1st-order stages (y += a*(x-y), a = 1-exp(-2*pi*fc/fs)) are stable and DC-exact; if ever required: JUCE BiquadCoefficients AND numeric pole radius < 1 AND DC gain checks before shipping; (3) body-ADD out-stage (worked +4 dB but 50 % NEUTRAL rebalance already reproduces the EMT body -- REMOVED); (4) denser onset pings: L1 dense-9-tap bank 42.7 to 29.5, Hadamard 42.7 to 25.1 (more in-band energy = higher floor = thinner peaks); (5) C3 near-miss (5 uneven taps sum 1.14, whip 0.026 KEPT): only +2.5 dB ping (37.15 to 39.70) vs C (3 taps, whip 0.015: 37.15 to 45.66, within 0.9 dB of ref 46.60) -- the lever is the FLOOR (kPlateBrightOnset), not tap count or sum; (6) extra series-LPF stage for Size law (can only darken -- wrong direction for size 1 = brighter; its low-band swamps the body at high-freq tail offsets -- rejected in favor of the corner shift kPlateSizeCornerFrac); (7) trained M/S split (the Haas-offset mechanism already gives a documented bounded image, S-M -4.06 dB at width 1.0; a mid/side gain would be an unmeasured constant -- documented as the model's MEASURED difference instead); (8) value-matching the reference comb (19.39 vs EMT 140's 14.71: different cavity physics; the model's own comb law -- growth with its own decay -- is pinned relative to its own baseline per ticket no-forced-match).

The Size dial (params_.size) was a NO-OP on the Plate path (mode 0 in V2 order) -- the 2026-10-13 user redirect: make it mean plate-class, not an arbitrary knob. SHIPPED law: a corner shift on the air-law two-stage LPF (kPlateSizeCornerFrac = 0.30 of the 4900-to-3600 Hz air-law range, +/-780 Hz per unit size) set in Reverb::setParams: sizeDelta = (0.5 - params_.size) * 2.0 * kPlateSizeCornerFrac; airFrac = jlimit(0,1, frac - sizeDelta); fc = kPlateAirHzBright - (kPlateAirHzBright - kPlateAirHzDark) * airFrac. MEASURED direction (hflf 6-12k vs 120-300 Hz @0.4-0.6 s, 2.0 s decay): size 0.0 = -59.9 dB, size 0.5 = -46.7 dB, size 1.0 = -35.3 dB -- size 1 (LARGE-PLATE class) is BRIGHTER, size 0 (compact) is DARKER; the first-draft physics guess (bigger = darker) was backwards and the measurement won. At size 0.5 sizeDelta = 0.0, so airLp_ is bit-identical to the pre-size-law 140 tuning (anchor). Guards (plate_family_tests.cpp SizeLaw): monotone brightening s1 > s5 > s0 (measured) and no comb growth at either extreme (comb 0.0=6.10, 0.5=19.39, 1.0=21.74; guard 19.39+1 dB at size 1). TODO (future ticket, NOT shipped): Chamber, Hall, and Digital reverb paths ALSO never read params_.size -- audit those paths the same way.

Each effect mode is a distinct DSP engine, not a preset, and its per-mode law + every CONSIDERED-&-DECLINED item in docs/agents/dsp-invariants.md and docs/agents/ir-reverb-training.md is a user-eared CONTRACT pinned by tests in test/src/: effect_tests.cpp, convolution_reverb_tests.cpp, plate_comb_tests.cpp, plate_texture_tests.cpp, plate_family_tests.cpp, budget_convolver_cost_tests.cpp, and more -- do NOT silently simplify the law back to a naive form (e.g. Compressor ratio law: detent 4:1 is the bit-identical keeper anchor, do NOT simplify to (n-1)/R which treated R as softness = INVERTED; chorus/tremolo kNumWaves must stay 5 together; BBD fc ~ 1/T from the SLEWED base tap). The delay design lives in plugin/docs/delay-modes.md; the IR training protocol + the plate/'140' instance + the biquad landmine live in docs/agents/ir-reverb-training.md.

The R2 shared-Mod contract (2026-10-15, SHIPPED at the thirteenth/final cut, commit 1aa620e): `Reverb::Params::sharedMod` (0..1, clamped in setParams) gates `processSharedModSmear` -- a post-mix, wet-unity ADDED multi-voice chorus layer on the WET reverb output (`out = wet + amt*dsum`; NEVER a crossfade, which the ear rejected for volume drop + anti-phase clicks). Mechanism constants (plugin/include/Reverb.h, region ~1050-1131 + processSharedModSmear at ~1913): kModVoices = 7 (6 delay lines v=1..6 of incommensurate depth/rate + the undelayed voice), kSharedModDepthMs = 18.0 (deepest voice at sharedMod 1), kModWriteTauMs = 80.0 (the CLICK FIX: ring-write one-pole smoothing on each voice's ring write), kModChorusAmt = 3.0 (layer amount, measured), a 6 kHz 1-pole/tap-filter per voice, and a smoothstep output taper so the layer is inaudible below ~50 % Mod. The fixed-sine Mod LFO uses `waveValue(0, phase)` (wave 0 = exact sine, the Digital read-tap anchor). OFF (sharedMod == 0, the default) the WHOLE path (incl. the per-voice biquad + delay state) is never entered -> all 6 modes bit-identical to the pre-R2 engine (pinned by R2_SharedModZeroIsBitExactAllSixModes at 15-digit level). The per-mode kSmearAmt/kFbDriftAmt swirl laws are NEVER scaled by the Mod knob (always-on, unchanged, bit-identity anchor). The standing rule (user m02589): ALWAYS MEASURE DSP changes sonically (probe/sweep tests in the real engine) -- never ship an ear-guess without the measured ladder. Ticket: docs/tickets/complete/reverb-dry-mod-width-swing.md.

R3 WIDTH LAW (2026-10-16, SHIPPED — supersedes any description of the reverb width as merely a per-bank tap-length drift): width is a TWO-LAYER control, coherent in all 6 reverb modes. LAYER 1 (RETAINED, bit-exact to pre-R3; present at the plain/Digital/Spring/Plate sites — Room/Chamber/Hall never used it): widthTapScaleFor(ch, numChannels) = (ch==0) ? (1.0 − 0.05*width) : (1.0 + 0.05*width) with kMaxWidthSpread = 0.05, i.e. ch-0 taps 5pct·width shorter, ch-1 5pct·width longer — the spectral-decorrelation baseline (a first R3 cut removed it and 1ch mono pins moved; it was restored). LAYER 2 (NEW, the ticket's 'match the convolver' ask): applyWidthHaas in plugin/include/Reverb.h (~:869) — a post-mix convolver-MATCHING Haas/M-S stage mirroring ConvolutionReverb's mono-IR spread constants kHaasDelayMs = 3.5 ms (kWidthHaasDelayMs) / kHaasDepth = 0.55 (kWidthHaasDepth), applied at EVERY mode's exit (7 call sites: plain ~:932, Digital ~:942, Spring ~:952, Plate ~:962, Room ~:974, Chamber ~:998, Hall ~:1087) BEFORE processSharedModSmear. Per sample: mid = 0.5(L+R) is stored in a per-instance power-of-2 ring (whRing_/whMask_/whWrite_, sized in prepare(), cleared in reset()); half = 0.5*width*kWidthHaasDepth*mid[d samples ago]*0.5; L += 2*half, R −= 2*half — i.e. side = width*0.55*mid[3.5 ms behind], split ± onto L/R. Properties: SUM-EXACT — (L+R)/2 unchanged at every sample, so every mono/level pin stayed green; GATED (widthHaasOn_ = 2ch buffer && width>0 && sampleRate_>0) — width 0 = bit-exact no-op (zero flops) and 1ch buffers (the production per-lane mode) are width-inert in layer 2, keeping only layer 1 (bit-identical to pre-R3). Net effect: Room/Chamber/Hall NOW respond to Width (previously inert); the stereo image is the convolver's Haas pair instead of a synthetic tap-length drift. P5 (PlateKnobLaw.StereoImageAtWidth1, test/src/plate_family_tests.cpp:716) re-measured under the two-layer law: tail [1.0, 2.5 s) at 2ch width 1.0 = mid −21.40 dB, side −24.91 dB = side-over-mid −3.51 dB (the pre-R3 tapScale-only measurement was −4.06 dB; the test's soft assertions sideE<midE and midE>−90 stay intact). DspTests 487/487 green; the reverb tile goldens (EffectTile kCompactKnobFace 32 px + label 12.0, the R3 UI addendum) were re-shot and verified at 0 px.
